citations.excerpt: A (partly) ecumenical council held at Constance , now in the Grand Duchy of Baden, from 5 Nov., 1414, to 22 April, 1418.

facts.value: Council that ended the Western Schism and acted against the teachings of John Wyclif and John Hus.

citations.excerpt: Its forty-five general sessions were devoted to three chief purposes: (I) The Extinction of the So-Called Western Schism
At various times the council dealt with current heresies , among them those of John Wyclif and John Hus .
